title: I'll Go Where You Want Me to Go
tune: ILL GO WHERE YOU WANT ME

sections.name: Verse 1
lines: [Ab]It may [Gm]not be on the mountain’s height
[Gm/Bb]Or over the stormy [Cm/G]sea,
[Gm]It may not be at the battle’s front
[Gm]My Lord will have need of me.
[Fm/C]But if by [Ab]a still, small voice He calls
[Gm]To paths I do not know,
[Gm]I’ll answer, dear Lord, with my [Bb]hand in Thine;
[Bb]I’ll go where You [Eb/Bb]want me to go.

sections.name: Refrain
lines: [Bb7]I'll go where you want me to go, dear Lord,
[Bb7/Ab]Over mountain or plain or sea;
[Ab]I'll say what you want me to say, dear Lord;
[Ab]I'll be what you want me to be.

sections.name: Verse 2
lines: [Ab]Perhaps [Gm]today there are loving words
[Gm/Bb]Which Jesus would have [Cm/G]me speak
[Gm]There may be now in the paths of sin
[Gm]Some wand'rer whom I should seek.
[Fm/C]O Savior, [Ab]if thou wilt be my guide,
[Gm]Tho dark and rugged the way,
[Gm]My voice shall echo the [Bb]message sweet;
[Bb]I'll say what you [Eb/Bb]want me to say.

sections.name: Verse 3
lines: [Ab]There's surely [Gm]somewhere a lowly place
[Gm/Bb]In earth's harvest fields [Cm/G]so wide
[Gm]Where I may labor through life's short day
[Gm]For Jesus, the Crucified.
[Fm/C]So trusting [Ab]my all to thy tender care,
[Gm]And knowing thou lovest me,
[Gm]I'll do thy will with a [Bb]heart sincere:
[Bb]I'll be what you [Eb/Bb]want me to be.
